propositions: The user-then-project configuration discovery walk is duplicated four times across config.py, show_config.py, and _config_resolvers.py, differing only in layer handling
Configuration composition logic (_ordered_layers + Config.from_mapping + merge_sparse) is duplicated in both _resolve and resolve_with_sources functions
A single raw_layers generator must consolidate all four discovery paths into one lazy, tolerant source iterator that yields RawLayer tuples
The _ordered_layers, _compose, and precedence functions must preserve existing monkeypatch seams for test instrumentation and module-size gating
File-discovery call sites in _config_resolvers.py must use in-body imports to preserve late binding and avoid import cycles
The refactored config.py must drop from 623 lines to below that ceiling while keeping all retired-environment-variable scanning and provenance tracking intact
